title: Native-first harness; custom code only for documented gaps
statement: Native-first harness; custom code only for documented gaps
body: Use native customization files for agents, instructions, skills, memory and approvals. Add custom code only where a documented requirement has no native answer. At this stage that is three small, dependency-free scripts: a `preToolUse` policy hook, an evidence recorder and a repository validator. Each is listed in the capability matrix with the requirement it satisfies.
subject: adr.0001
